Please support the original creator above, so we get more Misako! It's only 250 JPY/month (which is about $2 USD).

The song on the first page is actually a popular song from the Edo period called "Edo no Komori Uta". You can find various translations on the internet. Here is one example: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P0TiAo-eYuA
Below is the full song, enjoy:

SLEEP MY BABY, SLEEP MY LOVE,
CLOSE YOURS EYES, MY BABY, YOU ARE SUCH A GOOD BABY,
SLEEP MY DARLING, SLEEP.
WHERE'S YOUR NANNY? WHERE'S SHE GONE?
OVER THE MOUNTAINS SHE HAS CROSSED, TO HER PARENTS' HOME.
AS A SOUVENIR FROM HER HOMETOWN,
TELL ME WHAT SHE GAVE YOU, DARLING.
A SMALL RATTLE DRUM AND
A SMALL BAMBOO FLUTE.
n: [Misc] [Kill the King] Today's Misako - Good At Putting Children To Sleep (ENGLISH)
